title: Task 6: Replace model-facing SRD tool with lookup_rules
description:
Objective:
Move the default deterministic rules lookup tool and prompt from D&D-only `lookup_srd` to provider-neutral `lookup_rules`.

Files:
- Modify: `packages/core/src/orchestrator/tools.ts`
- Modify: `packages/core/src/orchestrator/protocol.ts`
- Modify: `packages/core/src/orchestrator/orchestrator.ts` if rules-resolution trace names require updates
- Modify: `packages/core/src/index.ts`
- Test: `packages/core/test/tools.test.ts`
- Test: `packages/core/test/protocol.test.ts`
- Test: `packages/core/test/e5.integration.test.ts`

Steps:
1. Write failing tests that the default registry includes `lookup_rules`, the system prompt names `lookup_rules`, and a D&D campaign lookup returns the goblin record through the campaign binding.
2. Update existing tests that assert `lookup_srd` as default behavior to assert `lookup_rules`; leave explicit compatibility tests for `lookup_srd` only if the wrapper remains exported.
3. Run `npx vitest run packages/core/test/tools.test.ts packages/core/test/protocol.test.ts packages/core/test/e5.integration.test.ts`; expected: FAIL.
4. Implement `lookupRulesTool` using `readCampaignRulesBinding`, bundled rules packs, `resolveRulesStack`, and `lookupRulesRecord`.
5. Keep `lookup_srd` registered only if needed for compatibility; otherwise export a wrapper function but remove it from the default prompt.
6. Update trace aggregation from `srdLookups` to a neutral key such as `rulesLookups`, with compatibility only where tests require it.
7. Run focused tests; expected: PASS.
8. Commit with `git add packages/core/src/orchestrator packages/core/src/index.ts packages/core/test/tools.test.ts packages/core/test/protocol.test.ts packages/core/test/e5.integration.test.ts` and `git commit -m feat-add-lookup-rules-tool`.
acceptance_criteria: Focused tools/protocol/e5 tests pass. Default prompt and registry use `lookup_rules`. Lookup results route through the campaign binding and include source/license metadata.
close_reason: Replaced lookup_srd in the default tool registry with provider-neutral lookup_rules backed by the campaign rules binding (default D&D SRD) and an explicit systemId override that targets bundled rules systems (D&D 5e SRD / Pathfinder 2e Remaster). System prompt now says lookup_rules and avoids SRD-only wording. Orchestrator rules-resolution trace key renamed srdLookups → rulesLookups. lookupSrdRecord and srd.test.ts retained as the lower-level legacy API. Verified: focused tools + protocol + e5 vitest pass (37/37 RED→GREEN), full npm run typecheck and npm run test pass (373 passed, 2 documented skips).
